text:
Jules: heads-up nightly invoices run_2026_03_21_02 produced several malformed PDFs. customers report missing prorated seat lines and a few received duplicate PDFs. creating thread to coordinate.
Carmen: can you drop a couple sample invoice ids and accounts?
Jules: samples: INV-LUM-0157, INV-ORCH-0044, INV-TRN-200. accounts: acct-lumen, acct-orchestra, acct-transect.
Diego: quick check in renderer logs shows PageOverflowException then a retry that requeued without idempotency_key, resulting in a partial file write followed by a second file. snippet:
```
2026-03-21T09:10:02Z ERROR renderer: PageOverflowException invoice=INV-LUM-0157
2026-03-21T09:10:03Z WARN queue: requeued job=54211 idempotency_key=null
2026-03-21T09:10:04Z INFO store: wrote tmp/inv_INV-LUM-0157_part.pdf
```
Priya: support confirmed first ticket at 09:18 UTC from Lumen. pausing collections for affected accounts.
Carmen: finance estimate?
Jules: ballpark $1,150 across affected invoices. will firm up once we enumerate.
Diego: fix plan: 1) ensure idempotency_key is passed from billing pipeline to render worker, 2) make renderer write atomic (tmp + rename), 3) run backfill to regenerate and dedupe. staging deploy in progress.
infra-bot: Deploy started branch billing/atomic-render -> staging
Carmen: CS to customers: hold messaging until regen completes. offering $25 courtesy credit.
Diego: ran dry-run backfill: `python tools/backfill_invoices.py --run run_2026_03_21_02 --dry-run` -> found 41 invoices with missing seat lines, 11 duplicates.
Jules: please pause the nightly runner until prod fix is live.
Diego: paused batch runner on invoice-host-3. pushing hotfix to prod.
infra-bot: Deploy to production succeeded @ 2026-03-21T10:52:14Z
Diego: prod backfill finished: regenerated 41 invoices, removed 11 duplicates, uploaded corrected PDFs, queued resend emails. summary: regenerated=41 deduped=11 duration=29m
Carmen: finance prepared credits $1,150. attaching approval for journals and will post after CS confirmation.
Priya: CS will send proactive notices later today with corrected PDFs. leaving thread for postmortem notes.
Jules: owners: Diego (fix + backfill), Priya (customer comms), Carmen (credits). add postmortem when ready. thanks everyone."
